title: Data Through Pictures
lesson: Start by identifying what is known and what must be found in the situations from ‘Data Through Pictures’. Explore data collection, then connect it to pictographs and keys and scales. Before accepting an answer, estimate or reason about its size, then explain why the method is valid.
